answer: Timed beacon witness. Each identity must return a signed response within a tight window after a public beacon fires; responses must carry a fresh measurement of a quartz oscillator's drift under temperature challenge, which is physically unique per device and cannot be simulated without the hardware. A whisper channel compares adjacent responses for impossible consistency. Cost: one physical device per identity, so N identities require N devices, and drift forging needs lab-grade thermal control per node.
